name: mw-jobs
description: Live mw jobs and news panes, settings and alerts

registry.title: Jobs registry file
registry.description: Optional JSON file that lists jobs. A missing file is normal: boards are discovered on their own. Per-job logs go in a logs folder next to it.

alertMilestone.title: Milestone closed
alertMilestone.description: How a closed milestone alerts: toast bubble, Notification Center notification, both or nothing. Notify works in terminals; the desktop app has no terminal channel, so it shows a toast instead.

alertNeeds.title: Blocked or needs you
alertNeeds.description: How an item that is blocked or needs you alerts. Notify works in terminals; the desktop app has no terminal channel, so it shows a toast instead.

alertDone.title: Item done
alertDone.description: How a finished item alerts. Notify works in terminals; the desktop app has no terminal channel, so it shows a toast instead.

alertNew.title: New item
alertNew.description: How a newly created item alerts. Notify works in terminals; the desktop app has no terminal channel, so it shows a toast instead.

alertSound.title: Alert sound
alertSound.description: Play Glass (milestone) or Ping when an alert fires.

alertMetric.title: Metric dropped
alertMetric.description: How a metric that got worse (a pass count down, a failure count up, a value moving away from its target) alerts. Notify works in terminals; the desktop app has no terminal channel, so it shows a toast instead.
